msItem.title: Royal chronicle from Dabra Libānos
msItem.note: Royal chronicle in Amharic, according to a note on (), copied from a manuscript, which possibly belonged to Śǝyyum Mängäša. The text occupies the left-hand pages, which bear odd page numbers. At various places, some passages with unclear readings have been left blank and some of them have been filled with pencil, e.g. .

msItem.incipit: ከኢየሩሳሌም፡ የወጡ፡ ፲፪ ሹማሞች፡ እነዚህ፡ ናቸው። በአኵስምም፡ ንጉሥ፡ በነገሠ፡ ጊዜ፡ ሠራዊቱ፡ እንደ፡ ሆሣዕና፡ የሰሌን፡ ቅጸል፡ ይዘው፡ ካህናቱም፡ መስቀል፡ ጥና፡ ይዘው፡ ከዳዊት፡ በ፻፲፯ኛው፡ አንቀጽ፡ ቡሩክ፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ በስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እያሉ፡ ይዞራሉ። ኦሪት፡ ነብያት፡ ወንጌል፡ ሐዋርያት፡ የካህናት፡ የመንግሥት፡ ነገር፡ የሚአነሣውን፡ እያነበቡ፡ ዳዊት፡ ሰሎሞን፡ እየደገሙ፡ ይጸልያሉ።

msItem.title: Genealogy of the Ethiopian Kings
msItem.note: A text that bears resemblances to that of the Short Chronicles, but does not follow it exactly. This list ends with the reign of Lǝbna Dǝngǝl.
msItem.incipit: ከዚህ፡ በኋላ፡ የኢትዮጵያን፡ ነገሥታት፡ የትውልዳቸውን፡ ታሪክ፡ እንጽፋለን። ሰሎሞን፡ ዕብነ፡ ሐኪምን፡ ወለደ፤ ይኸውም፡ ምኒልክ፡ ነው። እናቱ፡ የአዜብ፡ ንግሥት፡ ናት፡ ስሟም፡ ማክዳ፡ ይባላል። ዕብነ፡ ሐኪም፡ ቶማይን፡ ወለደ። ቶማይ፡ ዘግዱርን፤

msItem.title: History of Grañ
msItem.note: Dedicated to the war against ʾAḥmad. The chronicle stops with Galāwdewos (1540–1559) and the death of the king’s sister, Wälättä Qǝddusan.
msItem.incipit: እጽሕፍ፡ ነገረ፡ ግራኝ፤ የተነሳበት፡ ምክንያቱ፡ እንዲህ፡ ነው። በሱ፡ እጅ፡ ያላቁት፡ የሞቱት፡ የተሰደዱት፡ ፺፪፼ከ፫ሽህ፡ ከ፰፻ከ፺፭ናቸው። ዜናቸውን፡ እንጽፋለን፡ የሰማው፡ ሰው፡ ሁሉ፡ በሃይማኖት፡ እንዲጸና። የግራኝ፡ የልደቱ፡ ምክንያት፡ እንዲህ፡ ነው። አሕመድ፡ የሚባል፡ እስላም፡ ሐረርጌንና፡ አዳልን፡ የሚገዛ፡ ነበር።
msItem.explicit:
አጽናፍ፡ ሰገድ፡ በነገሠ፡ በዓመት፡ ከ፭ወር፡ ከ፳፪ ቀን፡ ግራኝ፡ ሞተ። በሞተ፡ በ፪ ዓመቱ፡ አበሻን፡ ገደለው፡ አፍርንጅ፡ በብዙ፡ ሀገር፡ ተማምለው፡ የኢትዮጵያን፡ ሲሶ፡ ሊሰጣቸው፡ ምሎ፡ ነበርና፡ ስለዚህ፡ ነገር፡ መኳንንቱ፡ ሊቃውንቱም፡ ከንጉሥ፡ ጋራ፡ ተጣሉ። ለምን፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ያጠፋሉ፡ ብለው፤ ከዚህ፡ በኋላ፡ መከረው፡ ብዙ፡ ከብት፡ ሰጥተው፡ ከሀገራቸው፡ ሰደዷቸው። እሱም፡ የአፍርንጅን፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ወዶ፡ ነበር፡ አፍርንጅ፡ ሀገራቸው፡ ከሄደ፡ በኋላ፡ በእስክንድርያ፡ ሃይማኖት፡ ፀና። አበሻ፡ በሞተ፡ በ፯ ዓመት፡ በ፯ ወር፡ አጽናፈ፤ ሰገድ፡ አዳል፡ ምድር፡ ዘመተ። በ፪ ዓመ

msItem.colophon: According to the colophon, this manuscript was copied from another manuscript that belonged to Grāzmāč Wareññā. It was written by Dagǝfe—whose brother was Fǝre Sanbat—at Dabra Libānos (to be identified with either ደብረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ or Dabra Libānos). ዝንቱ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ዘግራዝመች፤ ወሬኛ፡ ዘአጽሐፎ፡ በደብረ፡ ሊባኖስ፤ ወምስለ፡ ጸሐፊሁ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ወአባሲ፡ ደግፌ። ወንድሙ፡ ፍሬ፡ ሰንበት፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም፡ አሜን። ። ።

msItem.title: Various documents from a Gospel from Dabra Karbe
msItem.note: According to the note on (), copied from an old Gospel book from the church of Dabra Karbe of Zānā. The documents are mentioned and analysed in . At various places, some passages with unclear readings have been left blank and some of them filled with pencil, e.g. . The texts of the documents and their translations, as well as the preceding notes by Carlo Conti Rossini are presented in 72–77.

msItem.title: Letter of the ʿaqqabe saʿat ʾAmmǝḫā Laṣǝyon to the monks of Dabra Karbe
msItem.note: The text is preceded by a note on (cf. describing the position of the text in the Vorlage manuscript directly after the Gospel of Matthew. The incipit here is quoted from Stefan Strelcyn’s catalogue, while the second quotation and the explicit together with their translations are taken from 67.
msItem.incipit: እኤምሐክሙ፡ አነ፡ ዐቃቤ፡ ሰዓት፡ አምኃ፡ ለጽዮን። ሰላም፡ ለክሙ፡ ኵልክሙ፡ ማኅበረ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ መነኮሳት፡ እለ፡ ሀሎክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ደብረ፡ ከርቤ፡
msItem.quote: ሰማዕኩ፡ አነ፡ ከመቦ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ እለ፡ ኢተሐውሩ፡ በኅገ፡ መነኮሳት፡ እንዘ፡ ትሰመዩ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ዚአየ፡ ወትንብሩ፡ ምስለ፡ ዓለም፡ ገቢረክሙ፡ አብያት፡ ኀበ፡ ህልዋ፡ አንስት፡ ወካዕበ፡ ትትመየጡ፡ ውስተ፡ ደብረ፡ መነኮሳት።

I have heard that some of you do not follow the rule of the monks. Instead you are calling yourselves my children, you are living in the (secular) world, building houses near the residence of the women. Then you come back in the monastery.
msItem.explicit: ወይጽሐፍዎ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ክታበ፡ ውስተ፡ ወንጌል፡ ከመ፡ ይኩን፡ ሰምዐ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ማእከሌየ፡ ወማእከሌክሙ።
May this message be written in the Gospel, so that it will be a testimony before God, between me and you.

msItem.title: Fragments from the Maṣḥafa Milād
msItem.note: The text occupies the left-hand pages, which bear odd page numbers. The text is preceded by a note in Italian on (cf. ) describing the text and its position in the original manuscript. The beginning and the end are missing. It was described by Carlo Conti Rossini and Stefan Strelcyn as ‘History of Zarʾa Yāʿqob’, but identified as a fragment from the Maṣḥafa milād by Marie-Laure Derat in 65, i.e. ‘the lecture for taḥśaś 29, which is a celebration of king Zärʾa Yaʿqob’s victory over Badlay at the battle of Gomit’. According to Derat, the sequence of pages is arranged backward and the text is therefore in disorder.
msItem.incipit: እምድኅረ፡ ሞኦሙ፡ ለጸላእቱ፡ አዘዞሙ፡ ይኆልቁ፡ ኵሎ፡ አፍራሰ፡ ድርዕ፡ ወውላድ፡ ወሌጣ፡ አፍራሰ፡ ወቱኆለቈ፡ ልብሰ፡ ሐጺን፡ ጽሩር፡ ዘምስለ፡ ድርዕ፡ ወሐምበል፡ በበድላይ፡ ወዘሰራዊቱ፡ ወኮነ፡ ኆልቆሙ፡ አርባዕተ፡ እልፍ፡ ወአፍራስ፡ እለ፡ ይለብሱ፡ ልብሰ፡ ክሸድ፡ ስድስተ፡ ምእት፡

msItem.title: Announcement by Nagada ʾIyasus
msItem.note: An announcement made by ʿaqqāba saʿāt Nagada ʾIyasus stating that the monastery of Dabra Karbe must follow the rules established by Zarʾa Yāʿqob and ʾAmmǝḫā Ṣǝyon for Dabra Nagʷadgʷād, which could either be identified with Dabra Nagwadgwād or with Dabra Ḥayq ʾƎsṭifānos, but according to 70, Dabra Nagwadgwād is more probable. The announcement is followed by a list of the monastery’s possessions. The document is thought to date from the time of Zarʾa Yāʿqob. The text occupies the left-hand pages, which bear odd page numbers. The text is preceded by a note in Italian on (cf. ) describing the text and its position in the original manuscript. The following incipit is taken from the catalogue description by Stefan Strelcyn, while the translation is from 70.
msItem.incipit: ወልኡክ፡ ሰርፄ፡ ወልዱ፡ ዜኑ። ዐምዱ። ጸሐፍኩ፡ ወአውገዝኩ፡ አነ፡ ነገደ፡ ኢየሱስ፡ ዓቃቤ፡ ሰዓት፡ አእሚርየ፡ ዘከመ፡ ሠርዑ፡ ንጉሥነ፡ ዘርአ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወዓቃቤ፡ ሰዓት፡ አምኃ፡ ለጽዮን፡ ለካህናተ፡ ደብረ፡ ከርቤ፡ ከመ፡ ደብረ፡ ነጐድጓድ፡

I have written and I have threatened of excommunication, I, Nägädä Iyäsus, ʿaqqabe säʿat, learning how our king Zärʾa Yaʿqob and ʿaqqabe säʿat ʾAmḫa Laṣǝyon, made the rules for the priests of Däbrä Kärbe like (those) of Däbrä Nägʷädgʷad.

msItem.title: Śǝrʿatā dabtarā
msItem.note: Regulation by Zarʾa Yāʿqob on the dabtarā. Two ʿaqābe saʿāt are mentioned on : Nagada ʾIyasus and ʾAmmǝḫā Ṣǝyon. The text occupies the left-hand pages, which bear odd page numbers. The text is preceded by a note in Italian on (cf. ) describing the text and its position in the original manuscript.

msItem.title: Donation by śǝyyum Mazmura Dǝngǝl
msItem.note: Donation, which was granted by the śǝyyum of Zānā, Mazmura Dǝngǝl from the land of ʿĀdd Mǝrwā to the monastery of Dabra Karbe. In territorio di Medabai viveva una donna che disgraziatamente fu incinta da un serpente boa perchè essa si mise a lavarsi coll’acqua nella quale aveva orinato un boa. Il boa fu chiamato Aggabis
